title: Mysterious triangular craft 'as fast as fighter jet' revealed in new UFO files
excerpt: A mysterious triangular flying craft travelling as fast as a fighter jet is among newly released files on potential alien sightings.
content:
A mysterious triangular flying craft travelling as fast as a fighter jet is among newly released files on potential alien sightings.

The US Department of War (DOW) published the seventh release of “declassified and historical” Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena (UAP) – or UFO – files on Friday (23/10).

It features a 2026 witness testimony from federal law enforcement agents who detailed a triangular object rising to an estimated altitude of 200 to 300 feet.

They reported that it went from a static hover to rapid horizontal flight at a speed “compared to that as a military fighter jet,” but with no sound or apparent form of propulsion.

The witness statement reads: “The exterior remained uniformly featureless. Under infrared observation the entire airframe presented a spatially uniform thermal signature with no localised hot spots, engine heat signature, or exhaust plumes.”

It comes as part of the Presidential Unsealing and Reporting System for UAP Encounters (PURSUE), with additional files released on a rolling basis.

The US Department of War said on Friday: “Today, the Department of War is publishing the seventh release of declassified and historical Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena (UAP) files as part of the Presidential Unsealing and Reporting System for UAP Encounters (PURSUE).”

Announcing that it will release additional files at a later date, the department added: “The Department of War and our agency partners are actively working on the next release of UAP files.”
